# Wiring and Power Supply

## Complete Connection Diagram

```text
Raspberry Pi
  │
  │ USB / micro-USB cable
  ▼
ESP32
  ├── GPIO13 ── Servo 1 signal
  ├── GPIO14 ── Servo 2 signal
  ├── GPIO27 ── Servo 3 signal
  ├── GPIO25 ── Microswitch NO
  └── GND    ── Microswitch COM
       │
       └──────── GND external DC-DC supply

External regulated DC-DC supply: 5 V
  ├── +5 V ── Servo 1/2/3 power wires
  └── GND  ── Servo 1/2/3 ground wires
```

## Raspberry Pi and ESP32

The ESP32 is connected to the Raspberry Pi using its USB cable. This connection provides:

- electrical power for the ESP32 development board;
- the USB serial communication channel used by `gfxhat_pattern_ui_usb.py`.

In the tested setup, the ESP32 is detected as:

```text
/dev/ttyUSB0
```

## Servomotor Supply

The three servomotors must be powered by the external regulated 5 V DC-DC supply.

| Servo connection | Wiring |
|---|---|
| Servo signal 1 | ESP32 GPIO13 |
| Servo signal 2 | ESP32 GPIO14 |
| Servo signal 3 | ESP32 GPIO27 |
| Servo positive supply | External DC-DC `+5 V` |
| Servo ground | External DC-DC `GND` |

Do not supply the servomotors from the Raspberry Pi or ESP32 board.

## Common Ground

A common electrical reference is required for the ESP32 PWM signals to be interpreted correctly by the servomotors:

```text
GND DC-DC = GND servomotors = GND ESP32 = GND Raspberry Pi through USB
```

The external DC-DC `+5 V` is connected to the servomotors only; it must not be connected to the ESP32 power input while the board is already powered through USB.

## Microswitch

For a three-terminal microswitch:

| Terminal | Connection |
|---|---|
| `COM` | ESP32 GND |
| `NO` | ESP32 GPIO25 |
| `NC` | Not connected |

## Recommended Power-On Procedure

1. Verify all signal and ground connections with the servo supply off.
2. Ensure the printed servo arms can move without collision.
3. Connect the ESP32 to the Raspberry Pi through USB.
4. Turn on the external 5 V servo supply.
5. Launch the Raspberry Pi application.
6. Select a PNG and press `AVVIA`.
